rows.lemma: [hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ ḍākinīyuktāya brahmaṇe namaḥ mūlādhāre, hrīṃ trīṃ huṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ śākinīyuktaviṣṇave namaḥ svādhiṣṭhāne, ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ lākinīyukta rudrāya namaḥ maṇipūrake || ]
rows.grounds: embedded mantra sequence specifying bījas, syllables, deities, and locations
fused nyaset + ca + eva giving emphatic ritual instruction
compound describing the mūlādhāra as having four petals
